title: kratzmannia pectinata
intro: Kratzmannia pectinata, commonly known as the resurrection fern, is a unique plant species that can survive extreme conditions such as dehydration by rolling up its fronds and entering a state of dormancy. The health benefits of Kratzmannia pectinata include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to protect against oxidative stress, modulate immune responses, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of Kratzmannia pectinata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
